title: Improved Immiscible Diffusion: Accelerate Diffusion Training by Reducing Its Miscibility
tldr_zh: 把噪声指派推广为降低轨迹可混性，KNN 噪声选择 O(n)、0.2ms/256；CIFAR-10 DDIM FID 6.63→4.45，训练加速 >4×
tldr_en: Generalizes immiscible diffusion to miscibility reduction; O(n) KNN noise selection and image scaling give up to 4x faster training, CIFAR-10 DDIM FID 6.63 to 4.45.
key_numbers: Final FID CIFAR-10 DDIM/FM/CM: vanilla 6.63/4.92/10.22, KNN 4.45/3.56/9.16, linear assignment 5.14/5.02/8.54 (Table 3)
Assignment time at batch 1024: linear assignment 22.8 ms vs KNN 0.7 ms (Table 2)
Noise-cluster mean L2 distance: vanilla 0.92, assignment 4.11, KNN 2.17 (Sec. 4.2, Sec. 6)
KNN-selected noise KL to Gaussian 48.60 vs 48.25 for true Gaussian samples (Sec. 4.3)
Best k grows with dimension: 8/4/4 at 3072-d, 64 at 4096-d (Table 7); DDIM k=2..32 FID 4.94/4.77/4.45/4.85/5.19 (Table 8)
Baselines need 2.5-4.5x training steps to match (Fig. 5); PushT coverage 79.56% -> 82.83% (Table 6)
Noise perturbation W=20% leaves generated image nearly unchanged; 30% starts changing objects (Fig. 3)
